full.rationale: Rebaselined 2026-07-31 after the competitor-gap release. The 1.3.6-rc1 reference predates a large batch of shipped capability: metadata strip extended to WebP/SVG/HEIC/AVIF plus C2PA removal, XMP/DDS/gain-map facts in Image info, EXIF-IPTC-XMP carry-through on Convert and Resize, PDF page layouts, ComicInfo.xml in CBZ, pad-to-canvas resize, multi-size batch output, WOFF font previews, the eyedropper stash, and HDR screen capture. That is a deliberate +253 KiB installer / +922 KiB Rust payload, reviewed and accepted, not drift. The HDR capture stack (D3D11/DXGI/WinRT Graphics.Capture) is behind the APP-ONLY `hdr-capture` cargo feature precisely so the shell DLL does not pay for it; verified by `objdump -p`, which shows d3d11.dll and dxgi.dll imported by SageThumbs2K.exe and by NEITHER sagethumbs2k.dll nor st2k.exe. Keep later releases within 128 KiB compressed and 256 KiB for each raw payload unless an explicit reviewed policy change records why.

FIRST ARM64 FULL CALIBRATION, 2026-08-01, for the 1.6.0 release. ARM64 stopped being Compact: packaging/imagemagick-source-arm64.json pins the SAME upstream ImageMagick 7.1.2-29 Q16-HDRI release as x64, extracted from the official arm64 installer, so ARM64 now carries the long-tail format tier too. Measured from scripts/build-release.ps1 -Architecture arm64: installer 13,581,878 bytes (SHA-256 a375abb44345ecd9980be01ead63a3e7a81da01de17db0d2f894355d901e0d33), ImageMagick payload 35,198,128 bytes over 161 files, Rust payload 20,241,920 bytes. Every staged PE was asserted to be machine 0xAA64. WHY THE MAGICK PAYLOAD IS LARGER THAN x64 (35.2 MB vs 29.8 MB): the text-shaping stack (glib/harfbuzz/freetype/fribidi/raqm) is NOT stubbed on ARM64, because the stub generator is MinGW and MinGW emits x86_64 PEs regardless of target - the first attempt silently replaced genuine ARM64 DLLs with x64 stubs, which an ARM64 loader refuses. ARM64 therefore ships the real upstream DLLs, and the runtime prune is skipped with it since its candidates are only unreferenced once stubbing removes their importers. Building those stubs with the MSVC ARM64 toolchain would bring ARM64 back to x64 parity; until then this larger reference is deliberate and correct. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ATTEST: the installer has not been executed on ARM64 hardware, and three gates (magick runtime identity, bundle smoke, staged corpus regression) are deferred to the native arm64 CI job because an x64 host cannot run ARM64 binaries at all.
